annotations.title: Show an exchange on the connected HenryKnows page

description: Add a question and its HenryKnows answer (or a search and its passages) to the thread on the HenryKnows page the person connected, so they can see it there with its sources. Only for people who connected a page. Side effects: appends one entry to that page's thread (up to 100; a full thread refuses the entry and nothing is removed); the page stops working 24 hours after the last activity and a daily cleanup erases it; anyone with the page link can view it; nothing else changes.

answer.description: HenryKnows' answer text (omit for a search).

audience.description: The audience the answer was written for, as returned by ask_henry (omit for a search).

question.description: The question or search terms as the person asked them.

session.description: The session returned by connect (or the session code the person gave you).

sources.description: The sources HenryKnows returned, as given.

heading.description: The section heading within the source, if any.

name: share_to_page
title: Show an exchange on the connected HenryKnows page
